title: Harden Tier A CLI subprocess cancellation cleanup
description:
## Goal
Ensure exceptional/cancellation exits of run_arm cannot leave its own engine process group running.
## Scope
Only tools/tier_a/engine_cli.py subprocess lifecycle and cancellation regression tests in tools/tier_a/test_tier_a.py (or focused new test file).

Prefill diagnostic validation (sta-0a7), engine/CUDA code, Beads mutations by helper, GPU/SSH/live changes, otherprocess cleanup, commits or remote operations.

Offline mock cancellation plus real dummy child/grandchild tests prove no orphan survivors with bounded teardown. No new GPU engine launch.
